html:
Question 3
?

Find the locations of all of the critical points of T, where T is defined as

T:[uv]⟶[u2+3v2u−2v].

a
The critical points lie on the line v=23.
b
The critical points lie on the line 2u+3v=0.
c
The critical points lie on the line u=0.
d
The critical points lie on the line u=2v.
e
The critical points lie on the hyperbola u2−3v2=1.
